name: Arches National Park
policyReason: Pets can go only where cars go: roads, parking lots and campgrounds, not on trails.
summary: Pets can go only where cars go: roads, parking lots and campgrounds, not on trails.

excerpts.quote: Pets must be leashed at all times.
on any hiking trails, or anywhere off-trail, even while in a carrier

dogRules.text: Not on any hiking trail or off-trail (even in a carrier), at overlooks or in buildings.
Leash 6 ft or shorter, at all times.
Pets may not make excessive noise.
